sources.licence: CWWP2 LCS page: "There is no charge for the use of this data." and "These files are available for integration into your application" (https://cwwp2.dot.ca.gov/documentation/lcs/lcs.htm). Caltrans Conditions of Use, Ownership: "In general, information presented on this website, unless otherwise indicated, is considered in the public domain. Disclaimer: Caltrans gives no accuracy guarantee.
sources.statusReason: quoted text: public domain, no charge, offered for integration into applications; no feed-specific restriction found
sources.attribution: Caltrans (California Department of Transportation), cwwp2.dot.ca.gov; data as reported, not guaranteed accurate
